positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented and maintained Airflow data pipelines which feeds into Google Data Studio for dashboard/reporting for investors to consume.
- Performed data collection on alternative data to improve deal sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management.
- Ingested and transformed data from disparate sources (3rd party APIs/flat files) using a combination of Big Query, SQL, Python, Airflow, Pandas.
- Designed and implemented internal tool to automate monthly portfolio financial reporting using Python and Pandas.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
- Mentored an intern and provided technical support and guidance.
- Designed, implemented, and maintained a serverless ETL data pipeline, using AWS Glue, to extract and load data as large as 150 columns and 50 millions of rows.
- Temporarily supported other external teams by implementing an ETL data pipeline using Apache Airflow.
- Implemented IaC (Infrastructure as Code) with Ansible to provision/terminate AWS resources
- Researched and completed POCs (Proof of Concept) on ETL tools to evaluate possible replacement or add-on to homegrown solutions.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented a robust and scalable diff-comparison tool for computing differences between two large data sources using Apache Spark.
- Helped in designing and implementing an end-to-end asynchronous/synchronous ETL data pipeline using Flask, Docker, and PostgreSQL RDS, and REST API.
- Worked independently to implement Flexible Event Service (patented) to hook up data pipeline's web services via event callbacks using Celery and SQS.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented additional features on existing internal automated deployment services to increase functionality. 
- Implemented the automated creation of AWS instances' AMI snapshots and their auto scaling group along with their policies for multi-availability-zones deployment and application services scalability. 
- Tasked with deployment service debugging and manual/automated deployment testing.
- Dockerized applications for continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
- Ansible, Java, Python, Groovy, Docker

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:

- AWS, Python, Ansible

positions.title: Software Development Intern

- Java, Ansible, AWS, multi-threading, graphite

projects.title: Exploring the Belousov-Zhabotinsky Reaction With the Gillespie Algorithm
projects.description: Project that was done in Discrete Mathematical Modeling course. This project mainly focuses on the simulation of Belousov-Zhabotinsky (BZ) chemical reaction by utilizing Gillespie algorithm which uses stochastic simulation. This algorithm uses Monte Carlo technique to generate random numbers to determine the next reaction to occur with their time interval.

patents.title: FLEXIBLE EVENT SERVICE
patents.description: The current disclosure is directed towards systems and methods for automatically distributing an event comprising a plurality of key-value pairs, to a plurality of event subscribers, based on the plurality of key-value pairs satisfying one or more Boolean filters uniquely corresponding to one or more of the event subscribers, which may enable an increase in event distribution efficiency. In one example, this may increase event distribution efficiency by enabling a reduction in data exposure, as an event subscriber may receive only those events which satisfy a Boolean filter defined by the subscriber, and registered with the event conduit, and therefore, broadcast of events to uninterested subscribers may be reduced. Subscribers may specify interest in as broad, or as narrow a range of events as they wish, and thereby a more efficient match between subscriber interest and which events are distributed to that user may be enabled.
